public_rationale: The deadline has passed, but the paired totals are not established on comparable definitions. Alphabet's spending exceeded its component forecast, while Meta's was close. Microsoft's cited $13 billion was an annual revenue run rate, not realized annual revenue. These records neither validate the $18 billion total nor establish its precise miss. Missing AI revenue disclosures cannot be treated as zero.
limitations: This does not endorse the $327 billion spending forecast.
The spending and revenue portions could receive separate assessments with separate metric scopes.
Reading this as a contemporaneous summary of guidance would require different criteria from scoring realized outcomes.

criteria.support_condition: A reconciliation of the four companies' reported spending to the definitions behind the cited guidance, together with comparable realized 2025 AI revenue, establishes totals reasonably described as $327 billion and roughly $18 billion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A complete, comparable reconciliation establishes that either stated total materially misses the outcome. A run rate, one company's result, or a different spending definition is insufficient by itself.
